Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:7001: fontforge security update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
FontForge is a font editor for outline and bitmap fonts. It supports a range of font formats, including PostScript (ASCII and binary Type 1, some Type 3 and Type 0), TrueType, OpenType (Type2) and CID-keyed fonts. 

Security Fix(es):

* fontforge: FontForge: Remote Code Execution via malicious SFD file parsing (CVE-2025-15270)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

Criterions.Comment: Red Hat Enterprise Linux must be installed
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 is installed
fontforge is signed with Red Hat redhatrelease2 key
